title: Method of monitoring and trigger-locking a firearm
abstract: A method of monitoring and trigger-locking a firearm prevents unauthorized persons from firing the firearm. When a person picks up the firearm, a biometric scanner retrieves an unidentified biometric reading off of the person. The biometric scanner can be a palm-print reader and/or a fingerprint reader. If the unidentified biometric reading does not match an authorized user signature stored on a chipset of the firearm, and if the firearm has unlocked its trigger, then the firearm automatically locks its trigger. In addition, the firearm generates and broadcasts an unauthorized-use notification with a wireless communication module. If the unidentified biometric reading does match an authorized user signature stored on the chipset, and if the firearm has locked its trigger, then firearm automatically unlocks its trigger. The firearm also collects situational data from environmental sensors when the firearm discharges a round.

title: Intelligent weapon
abstract: A system for monitoring use of a weapon. The system includes a monitoring station and at least one weapon in which the weapon fires a projectile. The weapon includes a tracking device, in which the tracking device receives navigational data, and a transceiver. The transceiver transmits at least the navigational data to the monitoring station. The weapon can further include a biometric identifier for identifying a user and a trigger mechanism in which the biometric identifier can enable the trigger mechanism only when the biometric identifier identifies an authorized user. In one arrangement, the tracking device can be a global positioning system receiver that can receive navigational data from a plurality of global positioning system satellites.

title: Safety system with biometric locking applied in holders for size and controlled storage of firearms
abstract: SAFETY SYSTEM WITH BIOMETRIC LOCKING APPLIED IN HOLDERS FOR SIZE AND CONTROLLED STORAGE OF FIREARMS. The present invention patent application relates to a security system (1) described and applied to holsters (2) for the controlled storage of firearms. The present system includes a holster (2) with a locking mechanism (3) operated by a biometric sensor (4). Access to the weapon is restricted to authorized users whose fingerprints are recorded in the security system (1). The holster (2) is molded to fit specifically to the gun, ensuring a secure engagement and preventing accidental firing. The locking mechanism (3) has a locking handle (5) that covers the trigger of the weapon, blocking access to it. The locking handle (5) can only be unlocked by biometric authentication using the biometric sensor (4) strategically located in the holster (2). The biometric sensor (4) is highly sensitive and provides quick access to authorized users. The system also includes a locking base (6) with a locking mechanism (7), activated when an authorized user is identified by the biometric sensor (4), allowing access to the gun trigger. Powered by a battery (8), the system has an alert (9) for low battery. Additionally, it is adaptable to different types and sizes of weapons and can register multiple users, making it suitable for use in police or military forces. The field of application is directed to the sector of safety equipment, more particularly, in secure storage devices for firearms.

title: Firearm Safety Assembly
abstract: A firearm safety assembly for preventing the firearm from being discharged by an unauthorized user includes a processor coupled to a firearm. A trigger lock is coupled to the firearm. The trigger lock is operationally coupled to the processor. The trigger lock allows the firearm to be fired when the processor receives the authorized user's fingerprint and thumbprint. A GPS is coupled to the firearm. title: Gun System and Gun Control Management System Prohibit Gun Violence in Reactive and Proactive
abstract: The Gun System and Gun-Control Management System is a two part system to thwart gun violence in any places. The Gun System is a microprocessor with memory and supporting components that are embedded in the gun. The CPU of the Gun System executes software with data from the memory to identify authorized users with stand-alone electrical device; to discharge Unauthorized user with remote power switch or systems; to prohibit firearm use in restricted areas such as schools and other public places with GPS device and disable the gun trigger by moving it into the locked position with disabling device. In this way, the gun system thwarts gun violence in a reactive mode. The Gun-Control Management system maintains a plurality of database in communication with multiple gun systems to thwarts gun violence in proactive mode.

abstract: This disclosure provides a trigger lock system that includes a trigger lock that collects a fingerprint and unlocks when the fingerprint matches a stored fingerprint. The trigger lock in-cludes a wireless communication module, for example, Bluetooth module and a Thread module, such that it can connect to a user device by Bluetooth or internet through a Thread router. The trigger lock may be unlocked remotely by sending a command from the user device. The trigger lock may send information of each attempt to unlock the trigger lock by fingerprint to the user device. The trigger lock may send alerts to the user device. title: Biological fingerprint identification unlocking gun trigger
abstract: The utility model discloses a trigger for unlocking a gun through biological fingerprint identification. The gun trigger comprises a gun trigger shell, a gun trigger shell cover and a machine shell. Acontrol panel is mounted at the top in the gun trigger shell through screws; a fingerprint identification module is mounted at the top of the control panel through a limiting groove; a fingerprint setting key is mounted on one side of the bottom end of the control panel through a screw; a machine shell is arranged at the bottom end of the control panel. A motor is installed in the machine shell through an installation base. An output shaft of the motor is provided with a rotating wheel through a fixing piece; an oval limiting plate is installed at the bottom of the machine shell through bolts, a slidable L-shaped rack spring bolt is arranged in the oval limiting plate, a gun trigger shell cover is installed at the bottom of the gun trigger shell through bolts, and a reset spring is connected to the top of the gun trigger shell cover through a limiting clamping groove. The biological fingerprint recognition unlocking gun trigger is simple in structure, convenient to produce, high in unlocking efficiency, high in practicability and suitable for wide application and popularization.

title: Fingerprint recognition safety systems
abstract: A universal fingerprint recognition system for firearms that greatly reduces misuse and accidental discharge of a firearm. The fingerprint recognition assembly is completely embedded within the firearm to prevent tampering. A chip embedded in the trigger scans the firearm owner's fingerprint, and when recognized releases a safety pin, allowing the trigger to be pulled. A charging port embedded in the firearm's grip allows a USB-type connector to be attached and charge the battery chip in the CPU.

title: Multi-mode recognition intelligent gun cabinet
abstract: The utility model discloses a multi-mode recognition intelligent gun cabinet which comprises a gun cabinet body, the top of the gun cabinet body is connected with a fixing box through bolts, the top of the fixing box is connected with an alarm through bolts, and the top of the alarm is connected with an alarm lamp through bolts. The bottom of an inner cavity of the fixing box is connected with a fire extinguishing mechanism through bolts, and the right side of the bottom of the inner cavity of the fixing box is connected with a processor through bolts. Through cooperative use of the box door, the face recognition cabinet lock, the mechanical lock, the fingerprint coded lock, the intelligent coded cabinet lock, the alarm lamp, the alarm, the fixed box, the cabinet base body, the vibration sensor, the smoke sensor, the annular pipe, the dry powder extinguisher bottle, the electromagnetic valve, the nozzle, the connecting air pipe, the processor and the metal cabinet shell, the multi-mode recognition function is achieved; and the cabinet door can be opened in different unlocking modes, the automatic fire extinguishing function is achieved, and fire extinguishing can be conducted on the periphery of the gun cabinet in time.

title: Firearm with fingerprint recognition and electronic-control percussion function
abstract: The invention discloses a firearm with fingerprint recognition and electronic-control percussion functions. The firearm has the advantages that a fingerprint recognition device is arranged on the front surface of a trigger of the firearm, bullets can be percussed under electronic control of the firearm, fingerprints of a firearm holder are read by the fingerprint recognition device on the front surface of the trigger when the firearm holder pulls the trigger, a control circuit can be connected with an electronic-control coil if the firearm holder is authorized to use the firearm, accordingly, the bullets can be impacted by a firing pin of an armature and can be discharged under the electronic control of the firearm, and problems of unauthorized use of existing firearms and accidental discharge of the existing firearms can be solved.

title: Gun trigger locking fingerprint lock and control method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of firearm safety devices, in particular to a gun trigger locking fingerprint lock and a control method thereof, the fingerprint lock comprises an upper lock body, a lower lock body, a fingerprint identification module, a motor driving mechanism, a locking mechanism, a mechanical key unlocking mechanism and a control circuit, wherein the upper lock body and the lower lock body can be separated from each other. title: Biometric trigger lock
